information.title: information

items.p1: You may enquire for unlisted services (e.g. infographics, overlays, logos).
items.p2: I'm particularly interested in illustration, promotional posters, book cover arts, music video assets and stream assets (starting, brb, ending screen, etc).
items.p3: Depending on my schedule, I may accept game projects as well (e.g. visual novels, game icons, etc).
items.p4: Kindly be mindful of my workload (<0>work queue</0>). You may discuss scheduling and availability with us.
items.p5: Everything will be paid through PayPal.

information.thank-you: Thank you so much for the interest in my commissions!
